name: gh-actions-notifier
description: GNOME Shell extension for GitHub Actions notifications.

scripts.pack:modern: mkdir -p dist && gnome-extensions pack --force --out-dir dist --schema=schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.github-actions-notifier.gschema.xml --extra-source=core.js --extra-source=github.js --extra-source=secrets.js --extra-source=state.js extension-modern && mv dist/github-actions-notifier@opengrimoire.github.io.shell-extension.zip dist/github-actions-notifier-modern@opengrimoire.github.io.shell-extension.zip
scripts.pack:legacy: mkdir -p dist && gnome-extensions pack --force --out-dir dist --schema=schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.github-actions-notifier.gschema.xml --extra-source=core.js --extra-source=github.js --extra-source=secrets.js --extra-source=state.js extension-legacy && mv dist/github-actions-notifier@opengrimoire.github.io.shell-extension.zip dist/github-actions-notifier-legacy@opengrimoire.github.io.shell-extension.zip
scripts.pack: pnpm run pack:modern && pnpm run pack:legacy
